name: Sure Sync
author: Herman Mak
description: Match card charges from your self-hosted Sure ledger to trip cost estimates and swap them in with one tap, keeping titles, splits, bookings and receipts intact.

settings.label: Sure base URL
settings.hint: Base URL of your self-hosted Sure instance (e.g. https://sure.example.com or http://sure:3000). Add its hostname under Admin → Plugins → Sure Sync → Allowed hosts.

settings.label: Sure API key
settings.hint: API key from Sure (Settings → API Keys, sent via X-Api-Key; read scope is sufficient). Stored encrypted at rest. Only TREK admins can browse or import card charges with it.

actions.label: Test connection
actions.hint: Checks URL format, X-Api-Key authentication, Sure /api/v1 reachability, and active credit-card discovery, naming the first thing that fails.
